title: sharper aspect-true library thumbnails
description:
The library thumbnail looked soft (owner finding 2026-11-14):
the icon was developed at a 128px long edge while the row shows
76dp at ~420dpi (~200px physical), so the bitmap was upscaled on
display; and the single filtered createScaledBitmap from the
many-megapixel sampled decode aliases.

Sharpness:
- maxDim 128 -> 256 (ClipThumbnails): a power of two above the
  ~200px display need, so the row scales DOWN, never up. Applies
  to both paths (the MCRAW icon extract and the encoded preview
  render), both already upright and long-edge proportional.
- BitmapIconExtractor now downscales by iterative halving: while
  either dimension sits above 2x the target, halve with a
  filtered createScaledBitmap (each intermediate recycled); the
  last step is the one exact filtered scale onto the target,
  a no-op when the chain already fits. Degenerate 1px edges clamp
  to >= 1 as before. Example ch
